basics.name: Will Andersen
basics.label: VR/XR Specialist & Technical Consultant
basics.summary: I am a software engineer who specializes in C# and Unity development. I have created and contributed to a multitude of VR/XR, Desktop and Mobile applications used for Digital Twinning or as internal training processes for a variety of clients including state-funded research institutions, universities and their curricula, armed forces and private businesses.

work.name: MINDCONSOLE GmbH / XRCONSOLE
work.summary: XRCONSOLE combines digital transformation, immersive training concepts and XR training design in a unique synergy. Our expertise lies in seamlessly integrating each of these components to take the learning experience to a whole new level.
highlights: Developed a multitude of VR/XR training applications from start to finish for private businesses and state-funded clients
Created a modular and re-usable framework based on XRI from scratch to use across projects and devices
Advised clients on the best technical path forward and assisted in outlining project requirements.

work.name: SOMAREALITY GmbH
work.summary: SOMAREALITY specializes in developing eye tracking-based digital biomarkers, revolutionizing the way we understand and monitor cognitive processes in real-time.
highlights: Helped develop usage of scientifically validated cognitive digital biomarkers based on eye tracking in Unity
Created diverse training applications for the medical sector (incl. Medical University of Vienna), Austrian Armed Forces and third-party businesses for internal training purposes
Upgraded the existing central VR framework of the project team to a more maintainable one.

publications.name: Video compression for 3d media
publications.summary: Innovative middle-out compression algorithm that changes the way we store data.

references.name: Michel Varilek, CTO & Co-Founder at SOMAREALITY
references.reference: When Will Andersen joined our team (...), it was clear right from the start that he possessed a high level of technical aptitude and general knowledge. Will slotted seamlessly into the team and played a key role in significantly improving communication within the team. During my absence, he took the lead in our Scrum meetings and was able to independently continue, manage and present projects to our clients. (...) Will is an exceptionally competent Unity Engineer whose extensive knowledge and excellent people skills are a valuable asset to any development team.
